DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込先の変更についてですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want to change a transfer recipient, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。取引先から支店名が変わったと連絡が来ました。登録済みの振込先を直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 支店名変更の連絡を受け登録振込先を直したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. A business partner told me their branch name changed. I would like to correct the registered transfer recipient.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you received a branch-name change notice and want to correct the registered recipient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 口座番号や支店番号も変わっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have the account number and branch number changed too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 口座番号は同じですが、支店番号は変わっています。こちらが先方の案内です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同じ口座番号と変更された支店番号を案内で示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The account number is unchanged, but the branch number changed. Here is their notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Use the notice to show the unchanged account number and changed branch number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 新しい番号で検索して、表示される名義を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us search using the new number and check the account holder displayed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 表示された会社名は、案内と同じです。前の登録を使うと困りますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 検索結果の会社名が案内と一致すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The company name displayed matches the notice. Using the old registration would be a problem.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the company name in the search result matches the notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 古い登録を削除し、新しい内容で登録できます。今、振込みもされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can delete the old registration and register the new details. Will you also transfer money now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は登録の変更だけにします。請求書の金額がまだ決まっていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 金額未決定のため振込をせず登録変更のみ希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will only change the registration today. The invoice amount has not been decided yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request only a registration change, without transferring because the amount is undecided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、登録する画面へ進んでください。最後に内容を見直せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then proceed to the registration screen. You can review the details at the end.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 新しい支店番号と口座番号、会社名を確認しました。この内容を登録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新支店番号口座番号名義を確認して登録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked the new branch number, account number and company name. I will register these details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the new branch number, account number and account holder, then register. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 登録が済みました。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Registration is complete. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 取り置きの丸いパンを受け取りにいらした方ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to collect the round loaf we held for you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、山本です。このパンを半分に切ってもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 取り置きの丸パンを氏名で受け取り半分に切る依頼をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, I am Yamamoto. Could you cut this bread in half?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Give your name to collect the held round loaf and request cutting it in half. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: できます。さらに薄く切ることもできますが、半分だけでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes. We can also slice it thinner. Is just halving it all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 半分だけでお願いします。片方は今日食べ、片方は家で冷凍します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 半分だけと当日食用冷凍用の使い分けを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Just in half, please. I will eat one half today and freeze the other at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request only halves and explain eating one today and freezing one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 切りました。二つを同じ袋にお入れしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is cut. Shall I put both halves in the same bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 別々にしてください。冷凍する方は、袋のまま持ち帰りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二つを別袋で包んでほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Separately, please. I want to take the half for freezing home in its bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request separate bags for the two halves. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二つに分けました。焼きたてなので、まだ少し温かいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I have separated them. It is freshly baked, so still a little warm.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それなら、冷凍する前に家で冷まします。袋の口は開けておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 温かさを踏まえ冷ますため袋口を開けてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will cool it at home before freezing. Please leave the bags open.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Because it is warm, request open bags to let it cool. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 両方の口を軽く開けてあります。持ち運び用の袋も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Both bags are slightly open. Do you also need a carrying bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 手提げ袋は持っています。二つを倒さず入れて、会計をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 持参手提げへ入れ会計を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have a shopping bag. I will put both in without tipping them over, then please check me out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Put them in your own carrying bag and request checkout. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お会計はこちらです。ありがとうございました。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 演奏会の場所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a place to listen to the concert?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。音が大きい所は苦手なので、舞台から少し離れて聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大音量を避け舞台から離れて演奏を聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I do not do well with loud places, so I would like to listen a little away from the stage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to avoid loud sound and listen away from the stage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 芝生の後ろにもベンチがあります。そこから舞台が見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are also benches behind the lawn. You can see the stage from there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 座っても演奏者が見えそうです。予約席ではありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 後方ベンチの予約席かを確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It looks like I could see the performers even sitting down. Are they reserved seats?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check whether the rear benches are reserved. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのベンチは自由に使えます。開始は三時です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Those benches are free to use. It starts at three.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ十分あるので、先に座ります。休憩中に飲み物を買える所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 開始まで先に座り休憩中の飲料購入場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: There are still ten minutes, so I will sit down first. Is there somewhere to buy a drink during the break?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sit before the start and ask where to buy drinks during the break. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 売店はベンチの後ろです。演奏の間には十分の休憩があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The shop is behind the benches. There is a ten-minute break between performances.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 休憩に買いに行きます。途中で席を離れる時、荷物は持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 十分の休憩に荷物を持って売店へ行くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will buy one during the break. When leaving my seat partway through, I will take my belongings.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will take your belongings to the shop during the ten-minute break. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。再開の時は、舞台の司会が案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. The stage host will announce when the performance resumes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内を聞いて戻ります。今日は後ろのベンチで楽しみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 司会の再開案内を聞き後方ベンチで観覧すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will listen for the announcement and return. Today I will enjoy it from a rear bench.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to listen for the host's restart announcement and watch from a rear bench. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ、ゆっくりお楽しみください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 発券機でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the ticket machine?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。往復を予約したのですが、行きの券しか手元にありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 往復予約なのに行きの券のみ受け取ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I booked a round trip, but only have the outbound ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you booked a round trip but received only the outbound ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 画面には何と出ていますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「券をお取りください」と出ています。もう一枚、下の奥にあるようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発券機の表示と取り出し口奥の券を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says “Please take your tickets.” There seems to be another one farther inside at the bottom.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the machine's message and the ticket inside the output slot. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 取り出し口を見ますね。帰りの券が残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will look in the output slot. The return ticket is still there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: これですね。行きは六月十日、帰りは十二日で合っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 帰りの券を取り日付を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: This one, right? Outbound June tenth and return the twelfth are correct.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Take the return ticket and check the dates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 日付は合っています。領収書も一緒に出ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The dates are right. The receipt has come out too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 領収書も受け取りました。予約の完了メールだけでは乗れないと思って、確認に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 領収書受取と紙の券を確認しに来た理由を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have taken the receipt too. I came to check because I thought the reservation confirmation email alone would not let me board.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Take the receipt and explain why you came to check the paper tickets. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: これで往復の券がそろいました。取り出し口は空になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Now both tickets are here. The output slot is empty.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二枚を別のポケットへ入れます。帰りの券も忘れずに持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 往復券を分けて収納し携行を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will put the two in separate pockets. I will remember to bring the return ticket too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Store outbound and return tickets separately and decide to carry both. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、券をお確かめいただきました。いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, you have checked the tickets. Have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 収集所の案内についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about directions to the collection point?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。移転するという掲示を見ましたが、小さな地図では新しい場所が分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 小さい移転地図では収集所が分からないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I saw the relocation notice, but cannot find the new place from the small map.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help locating the collection point from the small relocation map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この大きい図でご案内します。今の場所は、ここですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will explain using this larger diagram. This is the current place, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。新しい場所は、川を渡った先でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新収集所が川のどちら側か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Is the new place across the river?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask which side of the river the new collection point is on. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 川の手前です。この角を曲がった所にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is before the river, around this corner.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 橋を渡らないのですね。いつから使う場所が変わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 橋不要を確認し変更開始日を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: So I do not cross the bridge. When does the place we use change?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm no bridge crossing and ask the starting date of the change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この案内では、来週月曜日の収集からとなっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: This notice says from next Monday's collection.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 日曜の夜に出すときも、新しい場所へ行けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 前夜に出す場合の場所と時間を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: If putting it out on Sunday evening, should I also go to the new place?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about the place and time when putting it out the evening before. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出せる時間は、こちらの地区の掲示でご確認ください。場所の変更日は月曜日です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check your neighborhood's notice for the permitted times. The place changes on Monday.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 時間は帰ってから地区の掲示を見ます。新しい場所の角に印を付けた図を持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 地区掲示で時間を確かめ位置図を持ち帰る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the neighborhood notice for the time when I get home. I will take the diagram marking the corner of the new place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the time on the neighborhood notice and take the location diagram home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの図をどうぞ。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the diagram. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 退院のお荷物はまとまりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you finished packing for discharge?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ほぼできましたが、この白いタオルは病院から借りた物だと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 退院荷物に病院タオルが混ざっていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Almost, but I think this white towel is one I borrowed from the hospital.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say a hospital towel is mixed into your discharge belongings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 端の印を見せてください。これは病棟のタオルです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show the mark on the edge. This is a ward towel.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分のタオルと一緒に袋へ入れてしまいました。まだ少し湿っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の物と一緒に袋へ入れ湿っていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I put it in the bag with my own towels. It is still a little damp.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it was packed with your own items and is damp. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの回収袋へ入れてください。ご自分の物は何枚ありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Put it in this collection bag. How many of your own do you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 青いタオルが二枚です。一枚は洗面台に置いたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の青い二枚のうち一枚の置き場所を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Two blue towels. I may have left one by the washbasin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say where one of your two blue towels may be. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 洗面台に青い物がありました。お名前の札が付いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: There was a blue one at the washbasin. It has a name tag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それは私のです。そちらを受け取って、白い物は回収袋へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 名札付きの物を受け取り病院の物を返す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: That is mine. I will take it and put the white one in the collection bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Take the name-tagged item and return the hospital's towel. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: これで青いタオルが二枚あります。忘れ物はほかにありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Now you have two blue towels. Is anything else left behind?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 引出しと洗面台を見て、そろいました。帰る前に白いタオルを返せてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 引出し洗面台と荷物の確認完了を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I checked the drawer and washbasin, and everything is here. I am glad I could return the white towel before leaving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report checking the drawer, washbasin and all your belongings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、確かにお返しいただきました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, we have received it back. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 道路の設備についてのお話ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about road equipment, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。家の近くの交差点で、鏡が反対を向いてしまっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 交差点の鏡が反対向きになったと知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. At the intersection near my house, the mirror has turned the opposite way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report an intersection mirror turned the wrong way. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日の強い風の後です。前は右から来る車が映っていましたが、今は空が映ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 風後に右方車両ではなく空が映ると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: After yesterday's strong wind. Before, it showed cars coming from the right, but now it shows the sky.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that after the wind it shows the sky instead of vehicles on the right. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 場所は、地図のどちらでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Where is it on the map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この交差点です。細い道から大通りへ出る所の、赤い柱の鏡です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 地図と赤柱で鏡の位置を特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: This intersection. It is the mirror on the red pole where the narrow road joins the main road.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Identify the mirror using the map and red pole. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 事故や、接触があったのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Was there an accident or contact?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 事故は見ていません。今朝、車で出る時に右側が見えず、危ないと感じました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 事故目撃なしと今朝の見通しの悪さを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I did not see an accident. When driving out this morning, I could not see the right side and felt it was dangerous.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you saw no accident and had poor visibility this morning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 設備の管理先を確認して、状況を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check who manages the equipment and pass on the situation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。鏡を動かそうとはしていません。撮った写真で、向きも見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分では動かさず写真で向きを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I have not tried to move the mirror. Please also check its direction in the photo I took.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you did not move it and show its direction in the photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 写真を拝見しました。ご連絡ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have seen the photo. Thank you for informing us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの書類をお送りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to send these documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。署名した契約書の原本です。相手から原本を送るよう言われています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 署名済み契約書原本の郵送を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It is the original signed contract. The other party asked me to send the original.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request mailing the original signed contract. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 中に、返していただく物も入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does it also contain anything you need returned?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 契約書だけです。そういえば、自分の控えをまだ作っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 契約書のみで未作成の控えに気づく。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only the contract. Come to think of it, I have not made my own copy yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say it contains only the contract and realize you have no copy yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まだ封は閉じていませんね。コピーを取ってから戻られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: You have not sealed it yet. Will you return after making a copy?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。一度持ち帰ります。原本を送った後では、この署名を見直せません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発送を中断し原本の控え作成を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will take it back for now. After sending the original, I would not be able to review this signature.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Pause mailing and decide to copy the original. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 近くのコピー機の場所をご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I can show you a nearby copier.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。二枚ともコピーし、原本だけを封筒へ入れて戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: コピー場所を聞き二枚複写後に原本のみ戻すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I will copy both sheets, then return with only the originals in the envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the copier and say you will copy both sheets and return only the originals to the envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 店の入口にコピー機があります。この窓口は、あと三十分開いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: There is a copier at the shop entrance. This counter is open for another thirty minutes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: それなら今行ってきます。コピーを自分のファイルへ入れ、原本の発送を改めてお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 残り受付時間を踏まえコピー保管後に再来する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will go now. I will put the copies in my own file and ask you again to send the originals.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Given the remaining opening time, decide to return after storing the copies. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。封筒をお返しします。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Here is your envelope back. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 家計の相談にお持ちの表ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is the table you brought for household-budget advice, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。毎月の支出は書きましたが、年に一度払う保険料をどこへ入れればいいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 年払い保険料を月次家計表へどう入れるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I wrote my monthly expenses, but am unsure where to put the insurance premium I pay once a year.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to include an annual insurance premium in a monthly household budget. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 保険料は、一年でいくらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: How much is the insurance premium per year?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 六万円です。来年の六月に払います。今月の支出へ六万円と書くと、今払ったようになってしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 年額六万円と来六月予定及び今月支出と区別したい意図を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Sixty thousand yen. I will pay it next June. If I write sixty thousand as this month's expense, it will look as if I paid it now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the annual sixty thousand yen, next June plan and wish to distinguish it from this month's expenses. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 支払予定として六月へ書き、別に月ごとの準備額を考えられます。六月まで十二か月ありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can write it in June as a planned payment and separately consider a monthly amount to set aside. There are twelve months until June, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。毎月五千円ずつ残せば六万円になります。月の表には準備する分として書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 十二か月で月五千円の準備を考える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Setting aside five thousand yen monthly makes sixty thousand. In the monthly table I want to write it as money to prepare.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Plan five thousand yen monthly over twelve months. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 実際の支払いと、残しておく分を別の欄にすると分かりやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Separate columns for actual payments and money to set aside would make it clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この右の欄を準備額にします。すでに家にある一万円は、別に予備費として残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 準備額の欄を設け既存一万円を別予備費として残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will use this right column for preparation. I will keep the ten thousand yen already at home separately as a reserve.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Create a preparation column and keep the existing ten thousand yen as a separate reserve. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、毎月の収入から五千円を残せるか、ほかの支出も見てみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then let us check other expenses to see whether you can set aside five thousand from monthly income.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見直すと用意できそうです。六月に払った時は支出へ記録し、準備欄を取り崩したことも書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 月五千円を確保し六月支払と準備資金取崩しを記録すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: After reviewing, it looks possible. When paying in June I will record it as an expense and also note the withdrawal from the preparation column.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to secure five thousand monthly and record June's payment and use of the prepared funds. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 表がまとまりましたね。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: The table is organized now. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 冷凍売場をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for the frozen-food section?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。冷凍うどんを買いたいですが、まだ野菜と米も選ぶ予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 冷凍うどん購入と他の買物が残っている事情を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want frozen udon, but still plan to choose vegetables and rice too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want frozen udon and still have other shopping to do. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 冷凍売場は奥です。溶けるのが心配なら、最後にお寄りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Frozen food is at the back. If you worry about thawing, stop there last.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それなら先に野菜と米を買物かごへ入れます。保冷バッグは会計まで畳んでおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 冷凍品を最後にし保冷バッグを畳んでおくと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I will put vegetables and rice in my basket first. I will keep the insulated bag folded until checkout.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose frozen items last and keep the insulated bag folded. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。冷凍うどんは五食入りの袋で販売しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Frozen udon is sold in bags of five servings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 五食入りを二袋買います。このバッグなら入りそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 五食入り二袋の必要量を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will buy two five-serving bags. They should fit in this bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify needing two five-serving bags. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自宅まで、どのくらいかかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: How long does it take you to get home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: バスで二十分です。家から保冷剤も入れてきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: バス二十分の帰路と持参保冷剤を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Twenty minutes by bus. I brought ice packs from home in the bag too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the twenty-minute bus ride home and your ice packs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 会計後の袋詰め台で、冷凍品をまとめて入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: At the packing counter after checkout, put the frozen items together in the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。米と野菜を選んでから冷凍売場へ戻り、会計後すぐバッグに入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 野菜米の後に冷凍品購入し会計後すぐ保冷収納すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will choose rice and vegetables, return to frozen food, and put it in the bag immediately after paying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will buy frozen food after vegetables and rice and pack it cold immediately after checkout. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞごゆっくりお選びください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your time choosing. Thank you.
